The top sign is white with black text in a non-Latin script (likely Hebrew or Arabic) and some English. The bottom sign is blue with yellow numbers ('50', '1', '25') and white text, appearing to be a highway or route marker. A smaller, darker sign is visible lower down on the pole. The background shows a hazy horizon with faint structures.
